description: This file defines the MetricsBuilder class within the Aws namespace, responsible for gathering and encoding metrics related to AWS SDK request processing, including appending various metric types, managing size constraints, and integrating with middleware.

classes.name: MetricsBuilder
classes.description: A class for building and managing request metrics within the AWS SDK, supporting appending metrics, encoding them, and integrating with request middleware.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the string of accumulated metrics, or an empty string if no metrics are collected.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the collected metrics into a comma-separated string.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a new metric if it does not exceed size constraints and is not a duplicate.

methods.name: identifyMetricByValueAndAppend
methods.description: Identifies and appends a metric based on provided feature group and value.

methods.name: appendSignatureMetric
methods.description: Appends signature-related metrics based on signature value.

methods.name: appendRequestCompressionMetric
methods.description: Appends request compression metrics based on the format.

methods.name: appendRequestChecksumMetric
methods.description: Appends checksum metrics based on the checksum algorithm.

methods.name: appendCredentialsMetric
methods.description: Appends credentials source metrics based on the credentials' source.

methods.name: canMetricBeAppended
methods.description: Checks if a new metric can be appended without exceeding size limits and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: fromCommand
methods.description: Retrieves a MetricsBuilder instance from a command object.

methods.name: appendMetricsCaptureMiddleware
methods.description: Creates and appends a middleware to capture metrics into the handler stack.
